title: Buying trousers
summary: Trying on trousers and asking for a cheaper price.

sentences.en: Hello, I'd like to buy a pair of trousers.

sentences.zh: 你看看这条黑色的，怎么样？
sentences.en: Have a look at these black ones. What do you think?
Not bad. Can I try them on?
Sure, you can try them on over there.

sentences.zh: 这条有点儿长。有没有短一点儿的？
sentences.en: These are a bit long. Do you have slightly shorter ones?

sentences.zh: 有，你试试这条白色的，比那条短一点儿。
sentences.en: Yes, try these white ones; they're a bit shorter than those.

sentences.zh: 太贵了！便宜一点儿吧，两百怎么样？
sentences.en: Too expensive! Make it a bit cheaper — how about two hundred?
Two hundred and fifty; I can't go any lower.

questions.prompt: What was wrong with the black trousers?
why: She wants shorter ones, so they weren't too short.
The price comes up with the white ones.

questions.prompt: What colour are the trousers she buys?
why: Right: 你试试这条白色的 — and she takes them.
The black ones were too long.

questions.prompt: How much does she finally pay?
why: Right: 两百五 — 250, and she says 我要了.
200 was her offer; he didn't accept it.
